> 第3章 一个打十个（第1页）
他体内接连不断的传出轰炸声，一条条经脉被强劲的药力硬生生贯通，爆发出滚雷般的轰鸣声。
他的身体经脉内部，骨骼内部，甚至骨髓内部，所有的杂质全都被强劲的药力贯通彻底，然后通过毛孔逼出体外！
短短一会，苏长歌体表的污泥又翻了一倍，形成厚厚的一层，如同穿了一件铠甲一样！
他感觉自己的身体越来越轻盈，越来越有活力。
身体内部也迸发出浑厚的力量，这种感觉真跟前世在小说上看的一样，源源不断，滔滔不绝，浑厚至极，深沉至极。
一股恐怖的气势从他身上席卷冲出，直接将身上的污泥铠甲炸的稀烂，无尽的烂泥崩飞，溅在地上化作齑粉！
这种感觉实在是太爽了，体内巨力翻滚，那一条条经脉通透无比，骨骼也顺畅无比，滚滚的灵气里面汹涌流动，为身体提供着源源不断的力量！
这代表着，他体内所有的杂质都被排空了！
经脉通透，骨骼通透，丹田通透，灵气在里面畅游，爽到发麻！
不过不着急，修士每次吸收天地灵气，那些灵气中都有杂质，长久以往修士体内还会产生杂质。
所以苏长歌一点也不慌，以后吸入杂质了，当场用洗髓圣丹洗掉！
旋即，他站了起来，双眼精光四射，炯炯有神。
比起之前，得到了翻天覆地的蜕变！
虽然身上的污泥铠甲被崩飞了，但还是有少许残留，必须要洗。
梨花峰后山有座清潭，苏长歌沿着山路，很快便抵达这里。
美美的洗了个澡后，他换上一身白衣，整个人出落的风度翩翩，俊美潇洒。
就在他要回去的时候，远处忽然传来一声暴喝！
他刚问了一句，立刻招到了王山的大骂：“师什么兄！
草，你送的什么垃圾丹药，看不起我是不是？”
还没来得及说话，王山脸色猛地变得无比难看，破口大骂道：“你送我一颗废丹，打发叫花子呢？”
“就算是打发叫花子，也不带这样的吧！”
“我今天不修理你一顿，我就不姓王！”
一个无法修炼的废物，竟然敢骑到他的头上？
王山死活也咽不下这口气，不愿意再废话，直接动手了!
一只铁拳破空而来，空气为之炸响，后天三重的修为全面爆发！
王山想也不想，直接断喝道：“什么确定不确定的，就你这样的垃圾，我一个能打十个！”
拳头轰碎空气，猎猎作响，疯狂逼近苏长歌的面门。
他已经能预料到，苏长歌被这一拳打的头破血流，横尸当场的情景。
望着拳头逼近，苏长歌脸色不变，风轻云淡的在衣袋里掏了掏，取出一件东西。
王山正在臆想，猛的看到苏长歌手中的东西，眼睛顿时瞪大，眼中流露出深深的不可置信！

> Chapter 3 One against ten (page 1)
There were continuous bombing sounds in his body, and the meridians were forcibly penetrated by the strong medicinal power, and thunderous roars erupted.
All the impurities inside his body's meridians, bones, and even bone marrow were completely penetrated by the powerful medicine, and then forced out of the body through the pores!
In just a short while, the sludge on Su Changge's body doubled again, forming a thick layer, as if he was wearing a piece of armor!
He felt his body becoming lighter and more energetic.
The powerful force also bursts out from inside the body. This feeling is really the same as what I read in novels in my previous life. It is endless, gushing, extremely rich, and extremely deep.
A terrifying aura swept out of him, directly blasting the mud armor on his body to pieces. Endless mud flew away, splashing on the ground and turning into powder!
This feeling is so good, the body is rolling with great force, the meridians are extremely transparent, the bones are also extremely smooth, and the rolling spiritual energy is flowing turbulently, providing the body with a steady stream of strength!
This means that all the impurities in his body have been emptied!
The meridians are transparent, the bones are transparent, the Dantian is transparent, and the spiritual energy is flowing freely inside, making you feel numb!
But don't worry, every time a monk absorbs the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, there are impurities in that spiritual energy. Over time, impurities will still be produced in the monk's body.
So Su Changge didn't panic at all. If he inhaled impurities in the future, he would wash them away with the Holy Marrow Cleansing Pill on the spot!
Immediately, he stood up, his eyes gleaming and bright.
Compared with before, it has undergone earth-shaking transformation!
Although the sludge armor on his body was blown away, there was still a little residue that had to be washed.
There is a clear pool on the mountain behind Lihua Peak. Su Changge followed the mountain road and quickly arrived here.
After taking a beautiful bath, he put on a white suit, looking elegant, handsome and unrestrained.
Just when he was about to go back, a loud shout suddenly came from the distance!
As soon as he asked, he was immediately scolded by Wang Shan: "Brother, what are you doing!"
Damn it, what kind of rubbish elixir did you send? Do you look down on me? "
Before he could speak, Wang Shan's face suddenly turned extremely ugly, and he cursed loudly: "You gave me a waste pill and sent me away as a beggar?"
"Even if you send a beggar, you won't do it like this!"
"If I don't fix you today, my surname will not be Wang!"
How dare a useless person who cannot cultivate dare to ride on his head?
Wang Shan couldn't bear to swallow this breath, and he didn't want to talk nonsense anymore, so he took action directly!
An iron fist came through the air, the air exploded, and the acquired third level of cultivation exploded in full force!
Wang Shan didn't even think about it and shouted directly: "What is certain and uncertain? I can beat ten of you for rubbish like you!"
The fist shattered the air, making a hunting sound, and crazily approached Su Changge's face.
He could already predict the scene where Su Changge's head would be bruised and bloody from the punch, and his body would be left lying on the spot.
Seeing the fist approaching, Su Changge's expression remained unchanged. He dug into his pocket calmly and took out something.
Wang Shan was imagining it when he suddenly saw something in Su Changsong's song. His eyes suddenly widened with deep disbelief in his eyes!
